BACKPORT: drm/i915/bios: throw away high level child device union All the child device config fields, including legacy, are now available in the same struct, so use it for everything. As this change touches plenty of code with "p_child", rename them to "child" while at it. Also do some simple unification and constification where not intrusive. This in the name of avoiding extra cleanup churn for the same lines as here. No functional changes. shrink_file_throttler: avoid trimming log_diff/ and console-ramoops log_diff files should be fairly precise, and they're also highly compressible (text). It makes for a better overall strategy to (a) avoid further trimming (this really hurts debugging) (b) still compress them later, if needed (c) victimize, e.g., 'reboot_current' files as an alternative console-ramoops files are also pretty important and not very large, so avoid trimming them. This is all just to work around the stupidity of the throttling algorithm we have -- it makes bad choices every time it kicks in, so we really have to hand-hold it.
